name: Life Natural
overview: Scripture reveals that natural life is marked by toil and sorrow as a consequence of sin, as seen in God's pronouncement to Adam that he will eat in sorrow all his days and return to dust (Genesis 3:17-19). Yet, even in the midst of life's trials, there is a call to faithfulness and doing good, exemplified by Hezekiah's earnest prayer and heartfelt repentance before the Lord (Isaiah 38:2-4). Life is therefore a pilgrimage shaped by both the curse of sin and the opportunity to walk in truth and righteousness.
